topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I can't believe it. I stumbled upon a stack of papers, tucked away in a drawer I've never had reason to open before. Pages and pages, all neatly typed, with my name woven throughout the lines. A story about us, or so it seems, but colored, twisted maybe, by their imagination. What does this mean? Why did they keep this from me? I feel like I've been left out, like I'm reading a book where I’m the main character but have no idea what’s really happening. I need to talk to them, to understand. But how do you talk about something so...intimate, yet so unknown?
